title: Annual Regional Conference in Dubai
summary: Flights, visas, hotel blocks and venue logistics for 140 delegates from four countries.
overview: When a regional technology distributor brought its partners together for its annual conference, it needed one team to handle everything from first booking to the closing dinner. Over three days in Dubai, we hosted 140 delegates travelling from Sri Lanka, the Maldives, Bangladesh and Nepal.

We arranged group air tickets on three airlines, processed every UAE visa and secured a block of 75 rooms within walking distance of the venue. Our team managed the conference hall, stage and audio-visual setup, and coordinated daily coach transfers between the hotel and the venue.

Four Let’s Fly coordinators travelled with the group and staffed a help desk in the hotel lobby throughout the event. On the final evening, we hosted an awards dinner on a dhow cruise along Dubai Marina, followed by an optional desert safari the next day for delegates staying on.
Every delegate arrived and departed on schedule, and the client has already asked us to plan next year’s conference in Singapore.

title: Beach Clean-up at Mount Lavinia
summary: Our team and 120 volunteers cleared over 600 kg of plastic from the shoreline.
overview: Our beaches are the first thing many visitors to Sri Lanka fall in love with, so caring for them is part of what we do. In August, the Let’s Fly team organised a morning beach clean-up along the Mount Lavinia shoreline, joined by 120 volunteers from partner companies, local schools and our own travellers.

Working in small groups along a two-kilometre stretch, volunteers collected more than 600 kg of waste, mostly single-use plastic, fishing line and glass. Everything was sorted on the beach and handed to a local recycling partner, with only a small share going to landfill.

We closed the morning with a short talk from a marine conservation volunteer about how plastic affects turtles and coral reefs off the west coast, and a simple breakfast for everyone who took part. We now run a clean-up every quarter and welcome anyone who would like to join.

title: Sales Incentive Trip to Bangkok
summary: A four-day reward trip for 85 top performers, with a river cruise and a gala dinner.
overview: To reward its top sales performers, a leading Sri Lankan consumer brand asked us to create a trip that felt special from start to finish. We designed a four-day Bangkok programme for 85 guests, with chartered seats from Colombo and a stay at a riverside hotel.

Days were split between guided visits to the Grand Palace and Wat Arun, a floating market tour, and free time for shopping. On the second evening, the group boarded a private dinner cruise along the Chao Phraya River, and the trip closed with a gala awards night at the hotel’s rooftop venue.
Our coordinators handled every detail on the ground, from airport fast-track to dietary requirements, so the client’s team could simply enjoy the trip with their colleagues.

title: Corporate Awards Night in Colombo
summary: Venue, stage production and guest travel for a 300-guest awards ceremony.
overview: For a financial services company’s annual awards, we managed a 300-guest evening in Colombo, including the venue, stage production, photography and travel for staff from twelve regional branches.
Guests from outside Colombo travelled in chartered coaches and stayed at two partner hotels, with breakfast and late check-out included so nobody had to rush home the next day.

title: Back-to-School Packs for Monaragala Students
summary: Bags, books and stationery for 450 children in three rural schools.
overview: At the start of the school year, many families in rural Monaragala struggle to afford basic supplies. With help from our travellers and corporate clients, we raised funds for 450 back-to-school packs containing a bag, exercise books, a geometry box and stationery.
Our team delivered the packs in person to three village schools, and the remaining funds paid for new library shelves and 300 storybooks for the smallest of the three.

title: Singapore Science Tour for Students
summary: Five days of museums, labs and Sentosa for 60 students and teachers.
overview: We planned a five-day educational tour to Singapore for 60 students and teachers from a Colombo international school. The programme mixed hands-on learning at the Science Centre and ArtScience Museum with Gardens by the Bay, a Night Safari and a day on Sentosa.
Two coordinators travelled with the group around the clock, and parents received a short update with photos every evening so they always knew how the trip was going.

overview: Our team met more than 2,000 visitors over three days at Travel Fair 2026 in Colombo. We launched new Maldives and Japan packages, offered on-the-spot visa advice and ran a daily prize draw for a weekend getaway.

title: Tree Planting at the Sinharaja Buffer Zone
summary: 1,000 native saplings planted to help restore forest cover.
overview: Working with a local conservation group, our team and travellers planted 1,000 native saplings along the edge of the Sinharaja Forest Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Each sapling is tagged and cared for by nearby village families for its first two years. We visit every six months to check on progress and replace any that do not survive.

title: Buddhist Circuit Pilgrimage to India
summary: A guided nine-day pilgrimage for 110 devotees to Bodh Gaya, Sarnath and Kushinagar.
overview: We organised a nine-day pilgrimage for 110 devotees to the most sacred Buddhist sites in India, including Bodh Gaya, Sarnath, Kushinagar and Lumbini across the border in Nepal.
The group travelled on chartered flights and air-conditioned coaches, with vegetarian meals throughout, an English and Sinhala-speaking guide, and a resident monk who led daily observances.
